reason: The primary CIF is valid and strongly supported: it round-trips as fully occupied Tl4C4N4O4 in the stated 6.338353 x 6.338353 x 7.402687 angstrom cell, reduces to an 8-atom primitive Ima2 structure, covers the important indexed reflections, gives an instantiated-CIF integrated-intensity R1 of about 1.52%, and has linear O-C-N units (1.181/1.168 angstrom) with no short-contact or coordination-shell failure. However, the set does not fully cover the concrete N-centered ordering ambiguity that alternative-3 retains. That file is only the Ima2 C/O orientation order. Fully occupied, primitive-inequivalent Ama2 and Pbcm C-N-O orientation orders instantiate in the same refined cell with the same linear 1.238/1.247 angstrom bonds and no overlap; their comparable exact-model integrated-intensity R1 values are about 2.376% and 2.380%, essentially the same as alternative-3 at 2.372%. Their strongest ordering reflections are below 0.06% of the main peak and below the profile noise, so the blind pattern does not reject them. These material element-ordering/symmetry realizations are absent and are specific viable branches another attempt can add.
